description: Source code for framebuffer handling and font rendering in Zephyr OS, including functions for drawing characters, lines, rectangles, text, and managing framebuffer state.

methods.name: byte_reverse
methods.description: Reverses the bits in a byte.

methods.name: get_glyph_ptr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the glyph data for a given character.

methods.name: get_glyph_byte
methods.description: Retrieves a byte from the glyph data at specified x, y coordinates.

methods.name: draw_char_vtmono
methods.description: Draws a monochrome character in vertical tiled framebuffer.

methods.name: draw_point
methods.description: Draws a single pixel point in the framebuffer.

methods.name: draw_line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points in the framebuffer.

methods.name: draw_text
methods.description: Draws text at specified position with optional wrapping.
